def clean_scoremargin(value):
    if pd.isna(value) or value == 'NaN':
        return np.nan
    # Convert to string if not already
    value_str = str(value).strip()
    # If it's "TIE", we'll skip it (it's not numeric)
    if value_str.upper() == 'TIE':
        return np.nan
    # Remove non-numeric characters except for negative sign and decimal point
    cleaned = re.sub(r'[^-\d.]', '', value_str)
    try:
        return float(cleaned) if cleaned and cleaned != '-' else np.nan
    except:
        return np.nan
